posts.title: Milan
posts.description: For the city of six and a half million people (counting all the small and not-so-small towns around it), Milan is surprisingly easy to navigate. And while the metro system helps to get around the city fast, it’s just delightful to walk the tree-lined streets of Milan-proper from one historical landmark to another.

posts.title: Catania and Taormina
posts.description: Not only is Catania a convenient gateway to Sicily, it is also a fairly large and very old city well worth the visit on its own.
